doesNotMeetItsOwnMinimum.declared: 3 to 6 propositions, at least 4 claims each (preregistration-v0.2.json, pilotArm.size)
doesNotMeetItsOwnMinimum.consequence: Only P1 meets the declared minimum. P2 and P3 are reported for structure only and are excluded from the primary tally. The shortfall is reported rather than resolved by lowering the bar or extending retrieval, per stopRule.
doesNotMeetItsOwnMinimum.cause: Roughly half of retrieval attempts failed: HTTP 403, 406 or timeout. Not a property of the world; a property of this retrieval method.

labelling.interRaterStatistic: undefined, not merely unmeasured — there is one rater. AGENTS.md boundaries 2 and 3.
labelling.whyNotBlinded: The sole labeller also computed the identities. The confirmatory design requires three independent labellers blinded to the identities; this pilot cannot satisfy that and does not claim to.

selectionBias.note: Propositions were chosen by the analyst after seeing that coverage existed. Two of three are institutional announcements, which is the maximal-syndication case and is expected to inflate the split factor relative to a random corpus. The third (a sporting result) was added deliberately as a contrast case where independent observation is plausible.
selectionBias.effectOnEstimate: The split factor reported here must not be read as an estimate of the real-world split factor. Corpus selection alone could account for it.
